INSERT INTO sessions (
            id,
            project_id,
            task_id,
            model_id,
            agent_type,
            started_at,
            status,
            tokens_in,
            tokens_out,
            cost_basis
        )
        VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'test-model',
            'worker',
            to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
            'completed',
            0,
            0,
            'unpriced'
        )
